name: get_weather_forecast
description: Get a daily weather forecast (temperature, precipitation, conditions) for a destination and date range, to help plan weather-appropriate travel itineraries. Supports forecasts up to 16 days out; for dates further in the future, rely on general seasonal knowledge instead.

location.description: Place name to get weather for, e.g. 'Kyoto, Japan'. Required unless latitude and longitude are both provided.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Provide together with longitude to skip geocoding.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Provide together with latitude to skip geocoding.

start_date.description: First day of the forecast range, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: Last day of the forecast range, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the location, e.g. 'Asia/Tokyo'.

error.description: Present only if the request failed, e.g. location not found.
